fact: The Seventh Annual Progress Report on the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities, gazetted 7 November 2025, records that SAPS piloted the VIRECOM remote sign-language interpreting system at five police stations and that GCIS used sign-language interpreters at government media briefings and printed Vuk'uzenzele in braille.
title: Status Report on compliance with National and International Obligations for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities: Seventh Annual Progress Report on Implementation of White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities covering 2022-2023
publisher: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities (Government Gazette 53629)
